property_summary: In the reference contract, transferOwnership reverts (leaving the owner unchanged) unless the caller is the current owner, whereas the mutant lets any caller take ownership, so the rule 'only a call from c.owner() can change ownership' holds for C but is broken by M.
change_summary: Remove the _checkOwner() call so anyone, not just the owner, can call transferOwnership and change the owner.
